scientific_question: For every held-out observation whose frozen denominator snapshot has a certified root-free coefficient box, what exact conservative upper bound covers prediction shift and observed residual for every denominator in that box?

bound_rule.radius: Use the certified lower radius from the parameter-box analysis, including capped lower bounds; do not use the uncertified upper bracket
bound_rule.numerator: Keep numerator coefficients fixed at the frozen fit; only denominator coefficients vary inside the certified box
bound_rule.pointwise_formula: For R=rho*sum(sigma_j*|x|^j), require |D|-R>0 and compute |delta f| <= |N|*R/(|D|*(|D|-R)); observed residual bound is |y-f_snapshot|+|delta f|
bound_rule.arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic for every held-out observation and all returned bounds
bound_rule.rooted_snapshot: Do not produce this bound for a snapshot with an existing root or without a certified positive denominator box
bound_rule.scope: Bounds cover every denominator in the certified box at the observed held-out x points only; no continuous-x global bound is claimed

prohibitions: No refitting, numerator perturbation or radius retuning
No probabilistic prediction interval, RMSE bound or calibration claim
No bound for rooted snapshots or points outside the supplied held-out observations
No description of a conservative upper bound as expected error or measured uncertainty
